The term "NDC distributor" can refer to
NDC Distributors
a national wholesale distributor of generic pharmaceuticals based in Cranbury, New Jersey
, or to member distributors associated with
NDC, Inc.
, a major U.S. healthcare master distributor based in Nashville, Tennessee, that supplies medical-surgical consumables.
NDC Distributors
NDC Distributors (Pharmaceutical Wholesaler)
Focus:
Specializes in generic prescription drugs and pharmaceuticals.
Operations:
Licensed across all 50 states, serving retail pharmacies, long-term care facilities, hospitals, and specialty clinics.
Compliance:
Accredited by the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) and compliant with the Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA)
NDC Distributors
NDC, Inc. (Healthcare Master Distributor)
Focus:
Acts as a master middleman connecting medical supply manufacturers with smaller, regional healthcare distributors.
Markets:
Supplies products for primary care, acute care, dental, physical therapy, home care, and veterinary fields.
Role:
Helps regional distributors efficiently access tens of thousands of medical products without needing direct manufacturer contracts.
